## Preview

This site is under construction. Hosts, download URLs, and some contact
details are still placeholders.
:::

The WHOI CMIP data server holds CMIP6 model output and reanalysis products
(ERA5 first) on WHOI's VAST storage at `{{< var vast_prefix >}}`, organized in
the standard CMIP directory layout and indexed by an
[intake-esm](https://intake-esm.readthedocs.io/) catalog.

- **[Browse the holdings](browse.qmd)**: filter by model, experiment, variable,
  and more, then copy paths, URLs, or a Python snippet.
- **[Use the catalog from Python](catalog.qmd)**, or start with the
  [quickstart notebook](notebooks/quickstart.ipynb).
- **[Get access](access.qmd)**: on HPC, over the SMB share, or by HTTPS
  download.
- **[Report a problem or request data](report.qmd).**
- **[Cite the server](cite.qmd)** in your publications.

News about the server, catalog releases, and maintenance windows is on the
[blog](blog/index.qmd).
